race.description: Yarradale Stud Ron Sayers Sprint Hcp (66+)
race.comment: The first of the features now and TIMELESS GEM (4) gets the nod. Resumes today on the back of a nice trial at Lark Hill. He draws the inside and boasts a strong first-up record. Can resume on a winning note. MONTE TREMEZZO (11) was solid last campaign and comes here off a short break with a nice trial under her belt. She gets in with no weight on her back and if she can be up to the mark off a freshen, she'll make her presence felt. EXCESS BAGGAGE (7) is better than she showed last time out and can bounce back to her best form. KEEP READING (3) can fire a shot first-up on the back of a nice trial.
